title: HB287 (2024 Regular): AN ACT relating to risk protection orders.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/24RS/hb287/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 2887033))
provenance.note: Introduced version (24 RS BR 1394); later amendments not in text read. No votes recorded. Section 2 quote is one clause of the reprinted section; it adds the new order to the existing exceptions.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (7) If after the hearing the court finds that the risk to public health, safety, or welfare as described in subsection (5)(c) of this section exists, the court shall enter an order prohibiting the respondent from purchasing, possessing, receiving, or having in his or her custody or control a firearm.
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (9) The Department of Kentucky State Police shall immediately make information about the order available to the National Instant Criminal Background Check System for the purpose of firearm purchaser background checks.
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (10) (a) Any person found in violation of an order entered under this section shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor. (b) Any firearm possessed in violation of this section shall be subject to forfeiture and shall be disposed of as provided in KRS 500.090.
Section 2 (KRS 237.104): (3) The provisions of this section shall not apply to the taking of an item specified in subsection (1) or (2) of this section from a person who is: (a) Forbidden to possess a firearm pursuant to KRS 527.040 or Section 1 of this Act;
